content.text: {"grade": 6, "complete": true, "main_gap": "Upper-bound construction in the refinement lemma (overlay of A- and B-intervals) is sketched with 'details omitted'; the cut count ≤ q-1 and the exact matching of cells are asserted, not verified.", "errors": [{"description": "The overlay construction for B≠∅ is only described in words and the key claim that it uses at most q−1 cuts is not proved. The count (≤|B| cuts in the A-row including the cut at s_B, ≤|A|−1 in the B-row, plus q−|A|−|B| bisections) is easy but omitted, and this construction is what Section 3 relies on.", "quote": "and use at most \\(q-1\\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted)."}], "notes": "Answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) with correct drafting-value lemma, a rigorous tree/bipartition lower bound D≥Γ, pigeonhole on subset sums for the upper bound, and the dyadic construction for the lower bound. All checked steps are correct; the only weakness is the sketched overlay construction."}
